# SPD-033 — Native deny rules for the ledger state directory, so it holds without the hook

## Brief
SPD-031 makes the edit hook refuse every Write and Edit into the gitignored ledger state directory at a project root (database, WAL, worktree cache, backups, the launcher's cached bytecode). Only the hook enforces it. SPD-016 gave Law 3 native deny rules (Agent isolation and model inherit) from spud settings sync, so it holds even where the hook does not run. Edit and Write deny rules for the home's state directory would do the same here as defense in depth.

Evidence: bin/spud_ledger.py edit_reason and in_state_dir (SPD-031, worktree spd-031-state-dir-edit-rule); the settings sync deny list written since SPD-016. Out of scope for SPD-031 by its brief, which forbids changing settings sync or native permission rules.
